name: Work sync
author: Enplace
summary: The shared engine work sources build on, like Linear, GitHub Issues and Obsidian.
description: Keeps a project's work in step with work that lives somewhere else. It isn't switched on by itself: each work source extends it and brings the client for its own app. It links each outside item to a work item, brings new items in (the first time as one batch, so it's one approval), and keeps titles, descriptions, stages, priorities, labels and due dates in step both ways, or one way if you choose. When both sides changed the same thing since the last sync, the later change wins and the other is posted as a note on the item. Nothing is ever deleted: work removed outside is marked done with a note.

settings.name: Sync
settings.help: Two-way keeps both sides in step. When both changed the same thing, the later change wins and the other is kept as a note.

settings.name: Statuses to stages
settings.help: Only if the guess is wrong: pairs like "In Progress = Doing; Backlog = To do". Anything not listed goes by what the status sounds like.

settings.name: Add new work there too
settings.help: New work you add here is created in the other app as well, where it can be.
